name: Brazil

keys.predictions: rows of prediction_panel for the panel, in column order
keys.aggregate: rows of aggregate at level country for the panel, in column order
keys.regions: rows of aggregate at level region for every state of the country, with the state's name from unit_regions; the displayed state value, a production-weighted aggregate of its leaves, never a pooling center
keys.clusters: rows of aggregate at level cluster for every weather-coherent growing region of the country (unit_clusters, lib/clusters.py), with the region's name; a production-weighted aggregate of its leaves, as the state rows are; the country stands as the cluster where a crop family has fewer than ten units
keys.aggregate_skill: rows of aggregate_skill for the country's aggregates (levels cluster, region, country): the full-record leave-one-year-out skill of the production-weighted mean of the unit predictions against the mean observed departure, skill_lo80/hi80 from 1,000 year resamples, skill_panel the equal-year unit skill on the same years; empty where the release carries no table
